text: I was impressed from the start by the friendly and helpful staff. What impressed me most was the female doctor in the first room (I don't know how many doctors there are, but the one who served me was a woman behind the counter). She gave excellent advice. Other places just want you to spend a lot of money on treatments, but the doctor here gave clear and logical explanations, found solutions, and helped me pay less. Highly recommend!
